title: Formal charge on ammonium nitrogen
statement:
In NH₄⁺, what is the formal charge on the nitrogen with four single bonds and zero lone pairs?

[_]{a}

explanations: This would make the formal charges sum to zero.
Four is the assigned bonding-electron count.

hints: It is assigned one electron per bond.
solution: Nitrogen contributes five valence electrons. It is assigned one electron per bond. Subtract the four assigned electrons. 5−0−4=+1.
